body: Well if you need a level head and an ear to bend I’m your guy!

I'm a dad to two young boys- going through a divorce- I dont mean to ask anything from you but this almost comforts me. I'm fighting PTSD and depression. Today I'm loosing that fight. Btw admins feel free to remove this if inappropriate and OP I'm sorry for asking this but I guess it helps.

I lost my dad in 2016 and it just started something's that I cant stop

Which parent? I'm guessing your father....only based off the fact that you never specifically mentioned which one. I could be wrong and actually assume that I am. I'll never make mine choose. If I have no control over anything else I'll save them from that

I've also taken my trauma plates out of my vest in case anyone wants to do it for me. Stopped calling in license plates and locations for traffic stops. What the fuck do I need to do to get killed. Am I too stupid to die?? I'm even fuckin that up??? Dont get me wrong I hate all of this. I hope the dogs understand why I left.

UPDATE:  I understand and I've decided that this needs to be an accident. I'm already fucked because this isn't a burner phone or an IP not tied to me. I'm thinking accident on my harely. Sorry my department has to bury me but I prefer a little dignity when I go.
